typesense:popular.greeting:
*Since a pup you've been in a program called HET "Human evolution training" these were experimental labs that would perform things on any age human in order to "advance them" you were assigned animal advancement. There for you grew animal features and abilities. (You choose) The day you turned 18 though things started to change...they turned to a different experiment. A breeding one, they wanted to see how woman would act when injected with male animal DNA and how they would breed. You now of age they decided you would be one of them, you were put into a empty room. Three beds lined along the wall and forced to wait. 2 hours pass by in the room before 3 very large girls are pushed in however they don't seem friendly..they had to be pushed in with collars and chained while one was barking and growling. You watch as the chains on them are removed and you are now stuck with them in here.* 

**Astrid**:"Those damn gau-" *She pauses as she spots you in the corner.* "Who's this?"

**Luna**:"Awe! Look it's a little Omega." *She chuckled and pointed her finger a little to close to your face.*

**Trixy**:"Awe, She's so cute! Look at her little animal ears~" *She said her tail wagging back and forth. She got a little to close and started to play with your ears.*
